Title: Scope and intent
Text: Repeated failures support an authentication-failure pattern, not a confirmed attack. Compare account, destination and successful-login evidence before reaching a compromise conclusion.

Title: Incomplete evidence
Text: Review rejected records, missing source addresses and processing limits. An incomplete report cannot establish the absence of other activity. Recover the source data and rerun before making a whole-file claim.

Title: Validate the original source
Text: Preserve the original event records and document normalization. For Windows failed logons, verify event 4625 and available source-address fields. Do not invent an IP when the source does not provide one.

Title: Check rule blind spots
Text: Slow or distributed attempts can evade per-IP thresholds. Benign repeated failures can also alert. Sensitivity uses retained trigger evidence only, not a full-input rerun.
